headline: The Social Reckoning is flopping at the box office
summary: Aaron Sorkin's 'The Social Reckoning' is significantly underperforming at the box office. The movie grossed only $5.5 million against a $30-42 million budget. Its poor commercial reception indicates a failure to connect with audiences.

headline: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
summary: Meta is accelerating its AI development, launching two new models. The company has introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full AI models. These new models are claimed to be competitive with industry-leading AI.

headline: Elon Musk has donated over $276 million to Republican midterm efforts
summary: Elon Musk has contributed over $276 million to Republican groups since July. This makes him the top known donor for the Republican party's midterm efforts. A substantial $158 million of his donations went to the Senate.

headline: The Yandex outage probably didn’t blitz Russian bots
summary: Ukrainian drone strikes reportedly took Russian data centers offline, but claims of plummeting bot traffic are questioned. Cloudflare data showed a decline, but it likely wasn't the malicious bot activity people imagine. The article debunks the idea that the outage specifically targeted Russian bots.

headline: Get a 2-Pack of 6.6ft Right Angle USB-C Cables for $5
summary: A deal offers a 2-pack of 6.6ft right-angle USB-C cables for only $5. This brings the cost down to just $2.50 per cable. These universal cables are ideal for devices like the Switch 2, Steam Deck, or iPhone 18.

headline: Satisfactory: The Board Game Preview
summary: A preview for 'Satisfactory: The Board Game' has been released. Fans can get an early look at the tabletop adaptation. The preview offers insights into the game's mechanics and design.

headline: Greta Gerwig's Narnia: The Magician's Nephew Wins Over Skeptical Fans With First Poster
summary: The first poster for Greta Gerwig's 'Narnia: The Magician's Nephew' has been revealed. The poster has reportedly won over previously skeptical fans. This positive reception hints at growing anticipation for the film.

headline: Will You Get a Paramount+ Subscription to Watch Avatar: Seven Havens?
summary: The new series 'Avatar: Seven Havens' is expected to be available on Paramount+. The article prompts viewers to consider subscribing to Paramount+ to watch the show. It highlights Paramount+ as the likely exclusive streaming platform for the Avatar content.

headline: Hundreds more prisoners to be freed in second phase of early release scheme
summary: A second phase of an early release scheme will see hundreds more prisoners freed. The plan includes inmates serving up to two and a half years for various crimes. This initiative aims to address prison overcrowding.

headline: Why the prime minister wants to talk about Brexit again
summary: For the first time since leaving the EU, the Prime Minister is ready to 'unflinchingly' debate Brexit. This marks a shift in the government's stance on discussing the UK's departure. The article explores the motivations behind this renewed focus on Brexit discussions.

headline: Government expands police support to political figures who are not MPs
summary: The government is extending police support to political figures beyond Members of Parliament. Shabana Mahmood emphasized the 'insufficient protection' previously offered to those in public life. This expansion aims to enhance security for a wider range of political individuals.

headline: Heating oil customers face tough winter despite shake-up promise
summary: Heating oil customers anticipate a difficult winter due to soaring bills. The government has promised better regulation for the heating oil sector. Despite these promises, customers face continued financial strain.
